chapter.verse: A hang pen kote in hih i leitung inn ahi puanbuk a kisiat leh Pasian' bawl innpum, khut tawh kibawl ahilo, vanlai ah a tawntunga kip, innpi khat nei ka hihlam uh ka kithei uh hi.
Tua hangin hih puanbuk sungah vantung innnuam puan silhbeh ding lunggulhin ka khuisa uh hi.
Tua bangin ka silhbeh takpi uhleh guaktanga om ka hikei pah ding uh hi.
A hang pen kote hih puanbuk sungah a om kimlai mah—a sithei pen nuntakna in a valhtum theih nadingin puan suahkhiatnop man ahilo, puan silhbehnop manin—vangik pua bangin ka khuisa uh hi.
Kote' ading hih bang thu hong vaihawmsak pen Pasian hi a, amah in khamkholhna ahi dingin Kha hong piaksa ahi hi.
Tua hangin kote lungmuangin ka om den uh a, leitung pumpi sungah ka teen laiteng uh Topa' kiangah a teeng nailo ka hihlam uh ka kithei uh hi.
A hang pen muhna tawh hilo-in upna tawh ka nungta uh hi.
Lungmuangin ka om uh a, pumpi pan paikhia-in Topa' kiangah teen ding ka utzaw uh hi.
Tua ahih manin ka tenna uh pumpi sung ahi-a mundang ahi zongin amah lungkimsak ding cih pen ka lungtuppi uh ahi hi.
A hang pen eite khempeuh Khris' thukhenna tokhom mai-ah a kilaak tek ding i hi a, mi kim in thuhoih ahi-a thusia ahi zongin leitung pumpi tawh i om lai-a i bawl thu tek tawh kituakin i ngah ding hi.
Tua hi a, Topa kihtakna thu thei ka hih manun midangte zong ka zol uh hi. Pasian' mai-ah ka kilang mahmah uh a, note' kitheihtawmna lungsim sungah zong a kilang dingin ka kilamen uh hi.

Note' kiangah koleko hong kiphattawm leuleu ka hikei uh a, lungsim sunga om thu sangin puatham melsuah a kisialhpih mite na dawnkik theih nading uh cihna tawh kote nong kisialhpih theih dingun siksan thu khat hong guan ka hizaw uh hi.
A hang pen lungmawl ka hih uhleh zong Pasian' ading hi a, lungpil ka hih uhleh zong note' ading ahi hi.
A hang pen Khris' hong itna in kote hong lenkip hi. Ka thukhupna uh hih bang ahi hi: Vekpi' taangin mi khat si khin ahih manin vekpi-in a si khin hita hi.
Vekpi' taangin amah si a, tua pen a nungta mite amau' ading khopin nungta nawnlo-in amau' taangin si-a a thokikpa' ading a nuntak nading uh ahi hi.
Tua hangin tu-a kipan kuamahmah cilesa zui-in ka en kei uh hi. Hun khat lai-in Khris nangawn cilesa zui-in en ka hih uh hangin tu-in ahihleh tua bang ka hi nawnkei uh hi.
Tua hi a, mi khatpeuh Khris sungah a om leh piansak thak ahi hi. A lui kisia khinta a, en un, a thak piang khinta hi.
Hih thu khempeuh Khris tungtawnin eite amah tawh hong kilemkiksak, kote' tungah leptuah seppina hong pia, Pasian' kiangpan ahi hi.
Cihnopna ah Pasian in leitung pen a tatkhialhnate ciamteh lo-in Khris tungtawnin amah tawh kilemkiksak a, kote' tungah tua kilemkikna thu hong ap hi.
Tua hi a, kote pen Khris' hong sawl taangmi uliante ka hi uh a, Pasian in kote' tungtawnin thumna kam hong sung hi. Pasian tawh kilemkik un, ci-in Khris' taangin note kong thum uh hi.
Eite Khris sungah Pasian' diktatna i suah theih nadingin Pasian in mawhna thu a theilo Khris pen eite' taangin mawhna thu suaksak hi.
